summary: Candidate is a distinct micro-skill focused on ranking a collection of documents by similarity to a query (top-K selection), with clear workflow and constraints. Peer candidates address different objectives: ad4956af computes single similarity scores (no ranking); c7278955 compares two documents (not query-document ranking); fcee8af2 is term normalization (preprocessing, not scoring). No redundancy detected. Supported by evidence section 6.3.3.
